subject.title: fix(acpx): keep leaked non-openai model out of the Codex ACP thinking slot

question: Should PR #95852 accept the additive ACP runtime contract fields and the drop-inherited versus fail-explicit Codex ACP model policy as the compatibility path for #95780?
rationale: The code appears correct, but the change expands ACP runtime/plugin contracts and changes provider/model fail-closed behavior, which repository policy treats as maintainer-owned merge risk.

options.title: Approve additive ACP contract
options.body: Land the PR after confirming `modelExplicit` and `appliedModel` are acceptable optional ACP runtime fields for this compatibility fix.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Ask the author to avoid expanding the ACP runtime contract and carry the effective-model signal through a narrower internal manager/backend path instead.

options.title: Reject default dropping
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers want Codex ACP to fail closed for both inherited and explicit unsupported models.

recommendation.title: Approve additive ACP contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR after confirming `modelExplicit` and `appliedModel` are acceptable optional ACP runtime fields for this compatibility fix.
